title: Penalty Surcharges by Type of Violation (Re: Article 23(3))
full_text:
Penalty Surcharges by Type of Violation (Re: Article 23(3))
■ Enforcement Decree of Internet Multimedia Broadcast Services Act [Appendix 5]

Penalty Surcharges by Type of Violation (Re: Article 23(3))

| Violation | Applicable provision of the Act | Penalty surcharge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Failing to commence business within 1 year from the date permission was granted, or continuously suspending business for 1 year or longer | Article 25(1) of the Act | 20/1000 of sales under Article 13(1) |
| 2. Failing to comply with an order under Article 10(2) of the Act | Article 25(1) of the Act | 15/1000 of sales under Article 13(1) |
| 3. Failing to comply with an order under Article 13(2) of the Act | Article 25(1) of the Act | 10/1000 of sales under Article 13(1) |
